about.description: Angren Power Insulators is a manufacturer of porcelain insulators based in Uzbekistan.
about.intro: Angren Power Insulators is a Uzbekistan-based manufacturer of porcelain electrical insulators, serving power utilities and industrial customers across Central Asia.
about.mission: To deliver reliable, high-quality porcelain insulation products that keep power infrastructure safe and running.
about.history: Founded in Angren, Tashkent region, our factory combines traditional porcelain manufacturing techniques with modern quality control to produce insulators used in substations and power lines throughout the region.
